tools.name: get_engagement_model
tools.description: Get how McGill Technologies contracts and bills: pricing structure, who owns the source code and IP at the end, and whether there is any lock-in or required retainer.

tools.name: get_discovery_instrument
tools.description: Get the Discovery Instrument: the fixed-fee two-week diagnostic that most engagements begin with, including fee, duration, deliverables, and how the fee is credited against a later build SOW.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the categories of work McGill Technologies takes on, with the situations each one typically applies to. Use this to determine whether a problem is in scope.

tools.name: check_capacity
tools.description: Check whether McGill Technologies can take on new work right now. Returns concurrent engagement slots, slots in use, and slots open. Call before proposing a start date.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get how to reach McGill Technologies and what the preferred first step is. Returns the contact channel and service area. Does not send anything.
